name: com.linknhv/linknhv
title: LinkNHV (New Haven, CT)
description: LinkNHV (Link New Haven): hand-picked websites for New Haven, Connecticut, checked by a person.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search LinkNHV (New Haven, CT), also called Link New Haven, the human-curated directory of websites for New Haven, Connecticut. Give keywords (e.g. "thai food", "food pantry", "pothole"), a tag, a collection, or a mix. Returns up to 10 listings a page (name, description, website, LinkNHV collection pages, last checked date); page through at most 5 pages. Typos are corrected and questions are matched to tags, as on linknhv.com.

tag.description: An exact LinkNHV tag name (e.g. "pizza", "downtown"); several comma-separated tags must all match.

collection.description: An exact collection or grouping name from list_collections.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Every collection in LinkNHV (New Haven, CT): hand-picked lists of New Haven, Connecticut websites on one topic (e.g. Restaurants, Food Pantries & Assistance, City Hall Contacts & Services), by section and grouping, with listing counts and page links. Use a name with search_listings or get_collection.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: One collection of LinkNHV (New Haven, CT): its description, its Featured picks (chosen by LinkNHV's editors), and its listings A-Z, 10 a page (at most 5 pages). Give the collection's name from list_collections, or the end of its page address (/c/<slug>).

collection.description: Collection name or slug, e.g. "Pizza" or "pizza".

tools.name: get_directory_info
tools.description: What LinkNHV (New Haven, CT) is, what it covers in New Haven, Connecticut, how listings are chosen and checked, and how to cite it.
